test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question some conditions or circumstances is provided to you, you have to make logical judgement according to mentioned circumstances and mark the correct judgement for question.

Statement: The government has decided to privatize all public sector banks.

Judgement I: It will improve efficiency.

Judgement II: It will reduce employment security.

options.text: Both Judgements I and II follow
Neither Judgement I nor II follows

solution:
**Statement:** The government has decided to privatize all public sector banks.

**Judgement I:** It will improve efficiency. ⇒ Privatization is generally associated with better management, competition, and improved services. Therefore, this judgement logically follows.

**Judgement II:** It will reduce employment security. ⇒ Privatization may lead to changes in job policies and reduction in job security for employees. Therefore, this judgement also follows.

Hence, both Judgements I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.
